newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends lower on dollar short supply.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends lower on dollar short supply.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.04 lower at 41.27 to the dollar in the kerb market on Tuesday amid short dollar supplies from abroad, dealers said.
The rupee was likely to open lower on Wednesday, one dealer said.
The State (central) bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on May 6, was 40.3300/40.5317 to the dollar.
The premium on the foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.35 percent compared to the opening at 2.50 percent.
